answerEnvelope.value: typed value, present only for provided
answerEnvelope.reason: nonempty for not_stated or not_applicable; not_applicable cannot bypass a positively triggered dependent requirement
answerEnvelope.documentIds: nonempty authorised attachment IDs for see_specification
answerEnvelope.remarks: optional contextual notes on every non-system field
answerEnvelope.basis: required nonempty for provided commercial answers
answerEnvelope.confidence: required for provided commercial answers: confirmed | estimate | indicative
answerEnvelope.selectionMode: required for multi_select and text_list; one of field selectionModes
answerEnvelope.otherDetail: stored in named conditional other field

recordShape.answers: request-scoped answers keyed by field ID
recordShape.variants: nonempty list of {id, label, answers}; variant-scoped section 5 answers keyed by field ID
recordShape.drafts: missing fields allowed; supplied values must remain valid

crossFieldRules.rule: none cannot coexist with any other selection within one variant
verbal_only cannot coexist with any other evidence choice
at least one milestone date provided OR timing_estimate provided with a nonempty estimate and basis
every referenced file belongs to this request and exists; one attachment may support many requirements
one numeric value per variant; alternatives use distinct variant IDs, never comma-delimited numbers

fields.label: Request categories
fields.notes: Multiple categories override the PDF single-choice instruction, per user decision.

optionLabels.B: New size or variant of existing product
optionLabels.C: Permanent change to an existing product
optionLabels.D: One-off non-standard variant for this customer
optionLabels.F: Tender/customer specification not met by current range

fields.label: Existing or competitor product code / description
Customer need and problem to solve
Target or indicative price
fields.notes: Structured amount, currency and per-m/per-km/per-drum basis; explicit estimate and basis required.

fields.label: Current supplier / competitor
fields.notes: Use explicit no-current-supplier answer through not_applicable with reason.

fields.label: Rated voltage
fields.notes: Preserve original notation; numeric kV and AC/DC context; optional U0/U/Um components. Never round to supported class.

fields.label: Earth / pilot / fibre core details
fields.source: Pilot clarification supporting PDF section 5 core count
fields.notes: Preserve original notation and counts separately from main cores.

fields.label: Conductor cross-section
fields.notes: Use separate variants for multiple numeric sizes; do not concatenate numbers.

fields.label: Applicable standards
fields.notes: Repeat number, edition if stated, clauses if stated; do not assume current edition.

fields.label: File attachments and references
fields.notes: Each file: private ID, type, title, reference/revision or explicit unknown, owner/time; drawing number for drawings.

fields.label: Tender submission / decision — consequence if missed
First commercial delivery — consequence if missed
Sales declaration
fields.notes: Must be true; no commitment to specifications, price or delivery; estimates identified.

fields.label: Assigned Sales / Branch Manager
fields.notes: Trusted eligible manager routing; never client-selected arbitrary email.

fields.label: Signed request revision
fields.source: Pilot revision control for PDF section 8

fields.label: Date received
fields.notes: Recorded only when the corresponding transition happens; not required on drafts.

fields.label: Received by
fields.notes: Recorded only when the corresponding transition happens; not required on drafts.

fields.label: Date acknowledged to Sales
fields.notes: Recorded only when the corresponding transition happens; not required on drafts.

fields.label: Date returned
fields.notes: Recorded only when the corresponding transition happens; not required on drafts.

fields.label: Receipt / return notes
fields.notes: A reason is mandatory on a return.

fields.label: Timing estimate and basis when no milestone date is known
fields.source: Pilot clarification for PDF sections 4 and 7
fields.notes: Require a timing estimate and nonempty basis; no-milestone-date condition applies across request dates.

valueTypes.text: nonempty trimmed string; maximum length defined per UI/API in Phase 2
valueTypes.number: finite JSON number, never a numeric string; enforce field minimum
valueTypes.integer: finite JSON integer, never boolean; enforce field minimum
valueTypes.boolean: JSON true/false; sales declaration must be true on submit
valueTypes.staff_id: server-resolved website staff identifier; never accept actor IDs as permission grants
valueTypes.multi_select: nonempty unique array of exact option strings plus selectionMode
valueTypes.text_list: nonempty unique array of nonempty strings plus selectionMode when defined
valueTypes.money: {amount: finite nonnegative number, currency: three-letter currency code}
valueTypes.money_rate: {amount: finite nonnegative number, currency: three-letter currency code, per: m|km|drum}; conversion_cost requires per=km; drum basis must identify drum length or explicit uncertainty
valueTypes.voltage_rating: {originalNotation: string, voltage_kV: positive number|null, currentType: AC|DC|not_stated, u0_kV?: number, u_kV?: number, um_kV?: number}; originalNotation required; do not parse ambiguous notation into a forced value
valueTypes.temperature_range: {minimum_C: finite number|null, maximum_C: finite number|null, originalText: string}; at least one bound or originalText; min<=max if both bounds provided
valueTypes.document_reference: {reference: nonempty string, revision: string|null, revisionState: provided|not_stated, attachmentIds: array}; revision required only for provided
valueTypes.standard_references: nonempty array of {number: string, edition: string|null, editionState: provided|not_stated, clauses: string[]}; edition required only for provided
valueTypes.attachments: nonempty array of {fileId: string, documentType: supported file evidence type, title: string, reference: string|null, referenceState: provided|not_stated, revision: string|null, revisionState: provided|not_stated}; file IDs belong to same request; drawing reference is its drawing number
valueTypes.core_groups: array of {kind: earth|pilot_earth|fibre_optic, count: positive integer, originalNotation: string, size_mm2?: positive number}; explicit not_applicable when absent

conditionSemantics.no_milestone_date_provided: none of budget_quote_date, firm_quote_date, sample_date, tender_date, first_delivery_date has state provided
conditionSemantics.scopeResolution: variant conditions resolve in the same variant; request conditions resolve in request answers
conditionSemantics.missingTrigger: draft condition unresolved; submission requires trigger answer first; never silently erase dependent stored answers
